I am here in Lilongwe, and this maize plot is the one that feeds my family. I went to school a little, so I can read the bag and I listen to what the extension people say on the radio, but I still farm the way my mother taught me. This year I managed to get the subsidy coupon like last season, so I will buy one bag of NPK 23-21-0 and one bag of urea for this plot — it is not enough for the whole 1.44 hectares but I will put it where the soil looks tired. I will use hybrid seed again because last year the SC 403 gave me a better harvest than the local seed my neighbor planted, and I still have some manure from the two goats I keep.
